select week_start::text as "from", (cutoff_date - 1)::text as "to",
      count(*) filter (where status = 'open' and
  (due_date < cutoff_date or due_at < cutoff))::int as overdue,
      count(*) filter (where due_date is not null or due_at is not null) > 0
        as "hasDeadline"
    from (
      select "tasks"."id" as id, week_start, cutoff_date, cutoff,
        coalesce(status_change.changes -> 'status' ->> 'from', "tasks"."status") as status,
        case when due_change.changes is null then "tasks"."due_date"
          else (due_change.changes -> 'dueDate' ->> 'from')::date end as due_date,
        case when due_change.changes is null then "tasks"."due_at"
          else (due_change.changes -> 'dueAt' ->> 'from')::timestamptz end as due_at
      from (values ($1::date, $2::date, $3::timestamptz), ($4::date, $5::date, $6::timestamptz), ($7::date, $8::date, $9::timestamptz), ($10::date, $11::date, $12::timestamptz)) as weeks(week_start, cutoff_date, cutoff)
      left join "tasks" on "tasks"."user_id" = $13 and "tasks"."created_at" < cutoff
      left join lateral (
        select "audit_events"."changes" from "audit_events"
        where "audit_events"."user_id" = "tasks"."user_id"
          and "audit_events"."entity_id" = "tasks"."id"
          and "audit_events"."entity_type" = 'task'
          and "audit_events"."event_type" in ('task.completed', 'task.reopened', 'task.cancelled')
          and "audit_events"."occurred_at" >= cutoff
        order by "audit_events"."occurred_at", "audit_events"."id"
        limit 1
      ) as status_change on true
      left join lateral (
        select "audit_events"."changes" from "audit_events"
        where "audit_events"."user_id" = "tasks"."user_id"
          and "audit_events"."entity_id" = "tasks"."id"
          and "audit_events"."entity_type" = 'task'
          and "audit_events"."event_type" = 'task.due_changed'
          and "audit_events"."occurred_at" >= cutoff
        order by "audit_events"."occurred_at", "audit_events"."id"
        limit 1
      ) as due_change on true
  ) as snapshots
    group by week_start, cutoff_date
    order by week_start
